name: Bambu Lab (拓竹 Tuozhu)
summary: Shenzhen-based consumer 3D printer company founded August 2020, best known for the X1/P1/A1 series and the AMS multi-material system. Bambu-branded filament is not produced in Bambu's own extrusion plants: per owner-verified records it is OEM-produced/resold via Sunlu and eSUN/Polymaker, all of whom manufacture in China. Catalog is broad (PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, PA/PA-CF, PC, PVA and dedicated support materials) and tightly integrated with Bambu's RFID/AMS ecosystem.

oem_relationships.notes: Owner-verified per research/verified-oem-relationships.md: Bambu-branded filament is resold/OEM production from Sunlu. No official Bambu confirmation of which SKUs.

Owner-verified per research/verified-oem-relationships.md (row 'Bambu Lab | Sunlu; eSUN/Polymaker'). Community consensus additionally suggests eSUN supplies core PLA/PETG/ABS volumes, but that line-level mapping is unverified.

Owner-verified per research/verified-oem-relationships.md. Community consensus additionally suggests Polymaker supplies engineering-grade lines (Support W/G, PA-CF); that line-level mapping is unverified and not officially confirmed by Bambu.

additional_notes: Standard PLA sits around $25-30/kg with premium pricing on specialty and engineering lines. Reputationally relevant (though not filament-related): 2023-2025 controversies over cloud outages and closed-ecosystem/DRM authentication restricting local and third-party slicer access. Reported to be IDG Capital-backed since 2023, but the control structure is an unverified detail. Build plates sold include Cool Plate, Engineering Plate, Textured/Smooth PEI and High-Temp Plate.

provenance.conflicts: Owner-verified ground truth confirms Sunlu and eSUN/Polymaker as Bambu's filament sources in general, but no official or reliable source maps specific SKUs (PLA Basic vs PLA Matte vs PA-CF) to a specific OEM. Community claims that eSUN handles core commodity lines and Polymaker handles engineering lines are unverified. Bambu has never publicly confirmed any OEM.
